description: Our dream is to be the best and the brightest one and hopefully we can shine like Sirius with our project.
summary: This Project makes an interactive map of the whole Jerezo crater which has been observed by the Perseverance rover and use those datasets to create a visually appealing and useful map of the Crater which in turn helps to create a route for any human expedition around the Jerezo Crater.
details: This is a interactive map of the Jerezo Crater on Mars which has been observed by the Perseverance rover. This uses the data given by Perseverance and combines everything to make the map of the place which will help any astronaut to guide the way and help understand the essential requirements. This is a HTML document and our team considered that the very basic should be the first thing which should be cleared hence instead of making a whole 3D simulation we stuck to a 2-D model which analysis the data and provides different outputs for different conditions and inputs.
